crossRefs.note: Yahweh called Samuel. He said, “Here I am.”
although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly…
“I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”
But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned…
God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
“Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled.…
Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions…
Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
translations.bsb: “Who are You, Lord?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,” He replied.
translations.kjv: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
translations.asv: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest:
